work_item.title: Dark/Light Theme Implementation
work_item.description: 🚩 AC Addressed (Required) Implement dark/light theme support Redesign query interface with modern, clean aesthetics 💡 What do you want to accomplish? (Required) Develop a comprehensive theming system using CSS custom properties that supports both dark and light themes with proper contrast ratios meeting WCAG accessibility standards. Implement intelligent theme detection that respects user's system preference on first visit, with a toggle control for manual switching and persistent storage of user preference across sessions. Create smooth theme transition animations and ensure all UI components, including syntax highlighting and data visualizations, properly adapt to both theme variants. 📋 Testability Considerations (Required) Visual testing for all components in both dark and light themes Accessibility testing for contrast ratios in both themes (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance) Browser testing for CSS custom property support and fallbacks User preference persistence testing across browser sessions Theme transition animation performance testing Integration testing with existing component library ⚙ Implementation (Optional) ✋ Technical Dependencies CSS custom properties support in target browsers Component library theming architecture User preference storage mechanism (localStorage/backend) 🛠️ Engineering Work To Be Implemented CSS custom property-based theming system Theme toggle component with state management Dark theme color palette design with accessibility compliance Theme-aware syntax highlighting for query editor Theme transition animations and performance optimization System preference detection and user preference persistence ⚠ Risks & Mitigations Risk: Theme switching may cause visual glitches or performance issues during transitions Mitigation 1: Implement CSS transitions carefully to avoid layout shifts Mitigation 2: Add option to disable animations for users with motion sensitivity Risk: Third-party components may not support custom theming Mitigation 1: Create theme adaptation layer for external components Mitigation 2: Select theme-compatible libraries or build custom alternatives

analysis.recommended_approach: Implement a CSS custom property-based theming system starting with defining accessible color palettes for dark and light modes. Build a theme toggle component with state management and persistence via localStorage or backend. Detect system theme preference on initial load and apply accordingly. Develop smooth CSS transition animations with options to disable for motion-sensitive users. Adapt existing UI components and syntax highlighting to be theme-aware. Create a theme adaptation layer for third-party components or replace incompatible libraries. Conduct thorough visual, accessibility, browser compatibility, and integration testing to ensure robustness.

implementation_steps.description: Define accessible color palettes for dark and light themes using CSS custom properties in theme.css, ensuring WCAG 2.1 AA contrast compliance.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify color contrast ratios with automated accessibility tools and manual checks.

implementation_steps.description: Implement themeUtils.js to detect user's system theme preference on initial load and provide helper functions for theme management.
implementation_steps.validation: Test detection logic across browsers and simulate different system preferences.

implementation_steps.description: Create ThemeToggle.js React component with state management to allow manual theme switching, including a toggle control UI and support for disabling animations for motion-sensitive users.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify toggle control updates theme state and respects motion preference settings.

implementation_steps.description: Develop userPreferenceStorage.js to persist user theme preference using localStorage with fallback to backend if applicable.
implementation_steps.validation: Confirm persistence across browser sessions and reloads.

implementation_steps.description: Integrate theme.css and themeUtils.js with existing component library to ensure all UI components adapt to theme changes, including syntaxHighlighting.css for code blocks and dataVisualizationThemeAdapter.js for charts and graphs.
implementation_steps.validation: Check all components render correctly in both themes with proper contrast and no visual glitches.

implementation_steps.description: Implement smooth CSS transition animations for theme changes in theme.css, with performance optimizations and option to disable animations for users with motion sensitivity.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify transitions are smooth without layout shifts or jank, and animations disable correctly when requested.

implementation_steps.description: Add graceful fallbacks in theme.css and themeUtils.js for browsers that do not support CSS custom properties.
implementation_steps.validation: Test theme functionality in legacy browsers and confirm fallback styles apply.

implementation_steps.description: Conduct integration testing to ensure third-party components adapt correctly or apply theme adaptation layer or replacements as needed.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify consistent theming across all UI including third-party components.

implementation_steps.description: Perform accessibility testing using automated tools and manual contrast checks to confirm WCAG 2.1 AA compliance in both themes.
Execute cross-browser testing to verify CSS custom properties support, theme detection, persistence, toggle functionality, and animations work as expected.
implementation_steps.validation: All supported browsers pass tests without regressions.

implementation_steps.description: Write unit and visual regression tests in test_theme.js covering theme detection, toggling, persistence, and UI rendering in both themes.
implementation_steps.validation: All tests pass and visual snapshots match expected appearance.

unit_tests: Test theme detection logic in themeUtils.js
Test toggle control state management in ThemeToggle.js
Visual regression tests for UI components in both themes

implementation.pr_description: Implemented a comprehensive dark/light theme system using CSS custom properties meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Features include intelligent system preference detection, manual toggle with persistent user preference, smooth animated transitions with motion sensitivity support, and full integration with existing UI components including syntax highlighting and data visualizations. Added fallbacks for browser compatibility and ensured third-party component theming consistency. Includes thorough unit, accessibility, visual regression, and cross-browser testing.
